sentences.text:
Chandrakanti And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4
June, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Heard Sri Sunil Kumar Dwivedi, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Shashi Dhar Pandey,
learned A.G.A. for the State.
2. The applicant herein has filed the present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C., 1973 for quashing summoning order dated 18.8.2023 passed by the Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division) Auraiya in Complaint Case No.6480 of 2022 (Uma Rajput vs. Chandrakanti and others) whereby the applicants have been summoned to face the Trial under Sections 323, 504, 506, 452 and 427 IPC, P.S. Auraiya,
District Auraiya.

entities.text: Uma Rajput vs. Chandrakanti and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that so far as the opposite party no.2 is concerned, she happens to be the mother-in-law of the applicant no.1.

He further submits that there happens to be matrimonial dispute already going on between the parties as the applicant no.1 had proceeded to launch proceedings which was registered as Case Crime No.101 of 2010, under Section 498A, 323,
Chandrakanti And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148372215/
1 504, 506 IPC in which Sections 82 and 83 of the Cr.P.C. proceedings have been initiated and further the proceedings are also pending with respect to Section 12 of the Domestic Violence Act and also under Section 125 of the Cr.P.C., however just as a matter of counter blast, the opposite party no.2 has filed the complaint with an allegation that the applicants had administered beating upon the opposite party no.2 despite the fact that the applicant no.1 is living all alone in her maternal house.

entities.text: Chandrakanti And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He thus submits that it is nothing but grosses misuse of process of law.

4. Learned AGA on the other hand submits that might be certain proceedings have been initiated by the applicant no.1 but what is to be seen is the fact as to whether any offence is made out and whether the summoning order could have been passed on the face of the said allegations.
5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. I am of the opinion that since the issues which the applicants seek to raise in the back ground of the criminal cases being initiated and launched by it is a defence and so far as the malicious prosecution is concerned the same also needs to be proved, however, the stage has not still arrived.

7. Accordingly, in view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court and in the case of M/S Neeharika, Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State Of Maharashtra and others reported in AIR 2021 SC 192, this Court finds its inability to interfere in the present proceedings at this stage.

entities.text: M/S Neeharika, Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State Of Maharashtra and others reported in AIR 2021 SC 192
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. Accordingly, the application stands consigned to record.

9. At this stage, the learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants shall prefer an application seek bail before the appropriate Court, the same be decided expeditiously as per the law available on the land.
In the opinion of the Court in case the such an application is preferred before the competent court then the same shall be decided with most expedition strictly in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 4.6.2024 Piyush  Chandrakanti And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148372215/
